g.text: -indexBatch(batch : List<Path>, firstDocId : int, docLengths : int[]) : int
build() submits one task per batch of 64 files.
Each task reads its files, tokenizes and stems them
into its own LocalAccumulator, records the token
count in docLengths[docId] (its own index range),
An unreadable file is skipped and counted.
shardCountFor(threads): smallest power of two >= 4 * threads.
One .txt per document, sorted by file name;
doc id = position in that list,
